04 · Proposed benchmark contribution

Audit conclusions must follow an evidence chain.

  • Cases combine corroborating and contradicting evidence across documents; no single template clue should reveal the label.
  • Record a minimally sufficient evidence graph, alternative explanations, and acceptable citations with explicit applicability rationale.
  • Give agents paid evidence actions and a fixed budget; score the conclusion and the investigation path.
Research design proposal. Novelty must be positioned against the verified related work; realism and annotations require independent accountant review.
Hidden gold remains outside every inference interface.5 / 8 · 1 minute
05 · Proposed economical method

Spend model capacity where evidence is ambiguous.

  • Run deterministic arithmetic and evidence consistency checks first; never select the answer using rule IDs.
  • Use small models to extract claims and rank retrieved governing paragraphs. Verify the paragraph against the specific error and evidence.
  • Allow calibrated abstention. Compare this cascade with one verified frontier reference and cheap/open-weight baselines on the same blind cases.
Measure accuracy, calibrated abstention, evidence coverage, action cost and latency.6 / 8 · 1 minute
06 · Feasible route to December

Freeze validity before the final model comparison.

  • October: accountant adjudication, citation policy, company-disjoint splits, source provenance and leakage tests; freeze a small pilot.
  • November: budgeted evidence cases, paired ablations, one frontier baseline, cheap model cascade; preregister exclusions and primary metrics.
  • December: held-out evaluation, company-level uncertainty, error analysis, dataset/code documentation and a reproducible submission draft.

Submission by December is a planning target. Venue eligibility, deadlines and acceptance must be checked independently; acceptance cannot be promised.

Release only material with established provenance and redistribution rights.7 / 8 · 1 minute
07 · Concrete decisions

Three gates before a publishable claim.

  • Can independent accountants identify the error and governing citation from only the permitted evidence?
  • Does performance survive template, company, clean-case and evidence-removal controls?
  • Does the economical method improve the paired accuracy–cost tradeoff on a held-out test, with uncertainty?
